control.description-key: Replaces a many-to-many (N:N) subgrid with a searchable multi-select lookup field. Selected records show as removable pills or chips that open the record when clicked.

data-set.name: records
data-set.description-key: The many-to-many (N:N) related records. Add this control to a subgrid that shows the related records of an N:N relationship.

property.name: relationshipName
property.description-key: Optional: schema name of the N:N relationship to add and remove records through, e.g. lops_matter_contact. Leave blank to detect it automatically from the subgrid - only needed when several N:N relationships connect the same two tables.

property.name: searchColumns
property.description-key: Optional: comma-separated logical names of additional columns on the related table to search against, besides its primary name column (always searched). Text columns are matched directly; a lookup column is matched against the primary name of the record it points to.

property.name: sortColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the related table to sort search results by, always ascending. Both text and number columns are supported. Defaults to the primary name column when left blank.

property.name: showInactiveRecords
property.description-key: If false (default), search results only include active records. If true, inactive records are included too.

property.name: resultLimit
property.description-key: Maximum number of matching records fetched and shown per search - re-queried from the server on every search, not a client-side page size.

property.name: placeholderText
property.description-key: Search box placeholder, shown to the right of the selected records.

property.name: labelColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the related table to display as the label for each record, in the drop-down list and the selected values, instead of the primary name column. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record - the first one with a value wins.

property.name: additionalDisplayColumns
property.description-key: Optional: semicolon-separated logical names of columns on the related table to show as smaller context text underneath each record name in the drop-down list. Every listed column value is shown, not a fallback chain. Choice, lookup, currency, date and number columns show their formatted display value.

property.name: tooltipColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the related table whose value is shown as a tooltip when hovering over a selected record. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record - the first one with a value wins. Without it the tooltip shows the record name.

property.name: sortBy
property.description-key: Order of the selected records in the field

value.name: View
value.description-key: The sort order of the subgrid view (default)

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Alphabetically by the displayed label, in the user language

value.name: Autofit
value.description-key: Arrange the selected records to fit into as few lines as possible, repacking when the field is resized

property.name: selectedDisplayMode
property.description-key: How the selected records are shown in the field

value.name: Pills
value.description-key: Each selected record is shown as a bordered pill with a remove button (default)

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Each selected record is shown as a borderless chip, like the out-of-the-box lookup field

property.name: componentHeight
property.description-key: Minimum height of the field. The field grows as selected records wrap onto more lines.

property.name: selectionShape
property.description-key: Corner shape of each selected record, in both the Pills and Text display

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display the selected record labels in bold font weight

property.name: iconColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the related table to render as each record icon. Point this at an Image column to show that picture, a text column containing an MDL2 icon name, or a Choice column whose option label is an MDL2 icon name or a web resource file name (e.g. logo.png) - detected automatically from the column type. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record. Use lookupfield.column (e.g. lops_parentaccount.lops_thumbnail) to pull the icon from the record a lookup on the related table points to.

property.name: iconFixedName
property.description-key: Optional: a literal MDL2 icon name shown for any record where Icon Column produced no value - or for every record, if Icon Column is left blank.

property.name: iconShape
property.description-key: Shape drawn behind each record icon or picture. Full fills the icons square box edge to edge (default). Rounded Square uses a small corner radius. Circle fully rounds it. None applies no shape or background at all, regardless of Icon Background Color.

value.name: Full
value.description-key: Square box, fills edge to edge (default)

value.name: None
value.description-key: No shape or background - icon or picture rendered with no box

property.name: iconBackgroundColor
property.description-key: Optional: hex color (e.g. #0078D4) painted behind each record icon or picture, in the shape set by Icon Shape. Blank by default - no background is drawn. Ignored when Icon Shape is None.

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Optional: hex color (e.g. #0078D4) applied to MDL2 icon glyphs. Blank by default - the icon takes the label color of the selected record, and #255BA4 in the list. Pictures and web resource images are not recolored.

property.name: selectionColor
property.description-key: Background color behind each selected record, in both the Pills and Text display (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB). The label, link and remove button use a darker shade of it.

property.name: pillBorderMode
property.description-key: Pills display only: whether each pill shows a border. Text display never shows a border.

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Pill border color property (default)

property.name: pillBorderColor
property.description-key: Pills display only: border color when Pill border mode is Custom color (hex, e.g. #255BA4)

property.name: hoverColor
property.description-key: Background of a record in the drop-down list while hovered or keyboard-highlighted (hex, e.g. #F3F2F1)

property.name: listSelectedColor
property.description-key: Background of an already selected record in the drop-down list (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)
